menu.name: Classic Country Loaf
menu.description: Our signature open-crumb sourdough with a crackly crust and tangy, complex flavor. Made with stone-milled whole wheat.

menu.name: Dark Seeded Rye
menu.description: A hearty, dense rye loaf loaded with caraway, sunflower, and pumpkin seeds. Perfect with cheese and charcuterie.

menu.name: Rosemary & Olive Oil
menu.description: Fragrant fresh rosemary folded through a rich, olive-oil dough. Pillowy inside, golden outside.

menu.name: Cinnamon Raisin
menu.description: A lightly sweetened sourdough swirled with cinnamon and plump California raisins. Beloved for weekend brunch.

menu.name: Sourdough Focaccia
menu.description: Thick, pillowy focaccia dimpled with flaky sea salt and fresh herbs. Order by the quarter-sheet.

menu.name: Starter Kit
menu.description: A jar of our 5-year-old sourdough starter with printed care instructions and your first recipe card.
